name: Meta Conversions API
description: Server-side integration with Meta's (Facebook) Conversions API: sends conversion events to Meta's Graph API from Drupal using a pixel ID and access token.
project_description: Integrates the Meta (Facebook) Conversions API with Drupal. Sends conversion events to Meta server-side via Facebook's PHP Business SDK, matched to a Meta pixel ID and authenticated with an access token, rather than (or in addition to) the browser-side Facebook pixel. Ships a PageView event out of the box, triggered from the client via an AJAX beacon to /ajax/page-view. Additional events can be sent programmatically through the meta_conversions_api.meta_client service's sendRequest() method. Modules can declare event names (hook_meta_conversions_api_event_names), rename them (hook_meta_conversions_api_event_names_alter), and gate whether any event is sent (hook_meta_conversions_api_allowed) for cookie-consent integration. Each declared event can be toggled off in the events config form. User PII (email, phone, name, etc.) passed to sendRequest is SHA-256 hashed by the Facebook SDK before transmission; client IP and user agent are added automatically. Configuration (access token, pixel ID, default action source, test event code, logging toggle) lives at /admin/config/system/meta-conversions-api behind the 'administer meta_conversions_api' permission.
